correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated complements with 8 and 7 edges (203490 and 116280 masks). For smaller shore size k=1,2,3, test each vertex's missing cross-degree against the opposite shore's size minus 2. These are all possible cut sizes, including singleton cuts. Zero immune graphs at 13 present edges also excludes fewer edges since adding edges preserves immunity. Exactly 15015 graphs at 14 present edges passed. Independently transformed the ten TSV edge sets under all 5040 permutations: the disjoint orbits exhaust those 15015 graphs, with sizes 105,2520,2520,1260,2520,1260,630,2520,1260,420. The redundant graph6, degree and automorphism columns also agree. Replay: /workspace/review-check-3.py (Python/NumPy); frozen C++ inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Finite order seven only; no extrapolation to other orders.
